It's National Small Business Week.

From the Lowcountry to the Upstate, small businesses are the backbone of South Carolina. The men and women running them work tirelessly every single day to keep our communities strong and our economy moving. We will always be here to support you. Get out there and shop local.

South Carolina STRONG.

Our amendment on Violet's Law making it into the House-passed Farm Bill is a win for animal rights across the country.

Dogs, cats, primates, hamsters, guinea pigs, and rabbits used in government-funded labs will no longer be put down when their time there is done. They will be rehomed and given the second chance they deserve.

Taxpayer dollars should never fund a death sentence for innocent animals.

Video

A government working for the American people makes sure money stays with the American people.


Speaker Mike Johnson (@SpeakerJohnson)

MILLIONS of small business owners around the country are seeing MORE MONEY in their pockets. 

For Main Street, the average tax reduction is nearly $7,000, thanks to Congressional Republicans and @POTUS's Working Families Tax Cuts.

Remember: The Democrats voted AGAINST you keeping your money.

To every predator in office abusing their power, abusing staffers, abusing women, you should be scared. 

We are on a mission to expose it all and we are just getting started. Sunlight is the best disinfectant. 

If you haven't already, read our piece in the New York Times: nytimes.com/2026/05/02/us/po…

This is happening far too often. Praying for President Trump's safety today and every day.


Eric Daugherty (@EricLDaugh)

🚨 NOW: Secret Service confirms an individual has been SHOT by law enforcement near the Washington monument — and the White House was briefly locked down during the incident, per AP

"ALL CLEAR" given and President Trump is safe, thank God 🙏🏻

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/EricLDaugh/status/2051397832779641274#m

This week we were one of few members who deposed billionaire Ted Waitt on his relationship with Ghislaine Maxwell.

His answer to too many questions was “I do not recall."

A billionaire with a close relationship to one of the most notorious enablers of child sex trafficking in history who visited the home of the former President of the United States, and his memory just happens to fail him. Particularly convenient.

Let's be clear about what is happening here. Powerful, wealthy men have spent y

Release the unredacted files. Prosecute the predators. Make the arrests.

The victims of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell have waited too long for justice. We made a personal promise to them and to ourselves to never stop until we deliver the accountability they deserve.

We won't stop until they get the justice they deserve.

Today marks one year since Logan Federico was taken from us.

She was 22 years old. A young woman with everything ahead of her, gone because a violent career criminal with nearly 40 prior arrests was allowed to walk free. Not once. Not twice. Nearly 40 times.

The people responsible for keeping him off the streets chose to let him walk free. Again and again. Logan Federico paid the price.

The system failed her. We will not forget her.

To her family, our hearts are with you today. We will never

President Trump has been successful with Iran. We saw him do it with Soleimani and with Maduro in Venezuela. He gets in, he gets out.

Iran now has basically no navy, no air force, and no ground game. President Trump has done this with extraordinary strength and we commend him for it.

Video

Over 80% of Americans support voter ID.

95% of Republicans. 71% of Democrats.

The AMERICAN people. This is a no-brainer.

The Senate needs to pass the SAVE America Act and get it to the President's desk before midterms. The integrity of our democracy depends on it.

Happy Teacher Appreciation Week. 

To every teacher across South Carolina, thank you. You show up every single day for our children, educating and shaping the next generation of leaders. 

Your hard work does not go unnoticed and we will always support you.

The best and bravest of them all.

Happy International Firefighters' Day to the men and women across our country who have answered the call to keep our communities safe, the ones who run headfirst into danger. 

Thank you for your strength, your sacrifice, and your unwavering commitment to protecting us all. We will always stand with you.

The results of my subpoena of Congress’s sexual harassment slush fund are in.

Nine members. One thousand pages.

All records prior to 2004 were destroyed - which tells you everything you need to know about how long this has been buried.

We are reviewing every page. We will name all nine. We will release the full 1,000 pages - once we confirm that personally identifiable information of victims and witnesses has been properly redacted.

Accountability is not a threat. It is a promise.

Since 2024, our office has secured more than $5 million in federal public safety funding for the Lowcountry.

✅ $625,000 to hire five new officers in Summerville
✅ $500,000 through the COPS Hiring Program for the Berkeley County Sheriff's Office
✅ $1.8 million in new equipment for first responders across Berkeley County
✅ $423,750 Port Security Grant for the Charleston Fire Department
✅ $1.8 million for drone capabilities for Joint Base Charleston and Charleston County Emergency Management
✅ Cri

Congress was built to serve the people - not protect the powerful. And it has operated in the shadows for far too long, and that darkness ends now. No member and no party gets a pass any more.

Sunlight is the best disinfectant. And we're bringing it.

Our shrimpers and fishermen should never have to struggle to compete with foreign competitors undercutting them while Washington looks the other way. We're making sure they don't have to.

South Carolina STRONG.
